title: Mertens products in arithmetic progressions over function fields
summary: We prove a function field analogue of Mertens' formula for Euler products over prime polynomials in arithmetic progressions in $\mathbb{F}_q[t]$, the counterpart of a formula of Languasco and Zaccagnini over the integers. An elementary argument shows that the product over the prime polynomials of degree at most $n$ equals $e^{-H_n}$, where $H_n$ is the $n$-th harmonic number, up to an exponentially small relative error.
